title: Buried for Centuries, Now Saving Water: Why India Is Reviving Its Ancient Stepwells
description: As water shortages worsen, communities across India are restoring centuries-old stepwells, ponds and johads to capture rain, recharge groundwater and build climate resilience.

title: Twenty years and 7,500 fossils reveal what blurs Earth's marine fossil record
description: In productive marine environments, a square meter (10.8 square feet) of seafloor can be perforated by hundreds to thousands of isolated and interconnected tunnels through which crawl and writhe a cornucopia of clams, shrimp, sea stars, sand dollars, snails, worms and other animals.
